Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.game.Game
public class Game extends Object
Domain aggregate of one Mesos match.

Game is the server-side model of a single match. It contains the rules and the mutable domain state, but it does not decide which network session is allowed to act. Session lookup, command ordering, and reconnection routing are responsibilities of the game controller and of the server session registry.

This class owns the complete match state:

  • the players that belong to the match;
  • the current era and lifecycle status;
  • the board, offer path, card rows, and player positions;
  • the current round phase and the phase player order;
  • the standard draft state and remaining draw quotas;
  • the connection state of each player inside this match;
  • the listeners that receive game payload updates.

The public methods are intentionally high-level commands. They validate the current state, delegate detailed rules to the proper handler, advance passive phases, and mark the aggregate as changed. For example, totem placement is delegated to TotemPlacementHandler, card drafting to CardDraftHandler, and automatic phase transitions to PassiveRoundPhaseHandler.

Connection resilience is modelled as part of the domain state through connectedPlayers. A disconnection marks the player as not connected and lets the current phase skip or adapt the turn order. A reconnection only marks the same player as connected again; it does not undo skipped actions and does not move the player backwards in the round flow.

Payload notification is centralized through GameActionExecutor. Public actions do not notify directly. They update the aggregate and the executor sends one payload only when the state version changed.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(int id, List<Player> players, Board board)
      Creates a new match in setup status.

      This constructor is used by the normal game factory when a lobby starts a fresh match. The first round order is not initialized here because the board setup happens in setup().

      Parameters:
      id - unique game identifier
      players - players participating in the match
      board - board prepared with fresh decks and the same players

  • Method Details

    • disconnectedPlayer

      public void disconnectedPlayer(Player player)
      Applies a real player disconnection to the domain model.

      The controller calls this method when a queued transport disconnect is accepted as a game event. From this point on the player is disconnected in the match model too.

      The method first marks the player as disconnected in connectedPlayers. If no player is connected anymore, the match is finished because there is no remaining participant able to continue it. During setup, the method only records the connection state: the initial phase order will later be built from the players that are still connected.

      During an active round, the current phase decides how to absorb the disconnection:

      • totem placement can skip the disconnected player in the placement order without changing the board position;
      • standard card drafting can return the current disconnected player to the starting tile and clear their remaining draft quota;
      • extra draw can skip the optional extra action.

      After the phase-specific handling, passive phases are advanced so the game does not remain blocked on a player that is no longer connected.

      Parameters:
      player - player who disconnected

    • reconnectedPlayer

      public void reconnectedPlayer(Player player)
      Applies a player reconnection to the domain model.

      Reconnection restores only the connection flag of the existing player. It does not create a new player, does not reset the board, and does not rebuild the current phase order. If the player was skipped while offline, that skipped action remains skipped. This keeps reconnection resilient without changing already processed game rules.

      Parameters:
      player - player who reconnected

      public void notifyError(String code, String message)

    • reportPhaseError

      public void reportPhaseError(Listener target)
      Sends a phase error to one listener.

      This method is kept for controller paths that need to reject a command before executing a full game action.

      Parameters:
      target - listener that must receive the error

    • setup

      public void setup()
      Performs the initial setup of the match.

      Setup builds the offer path, fills the initial visible card rows, applies the initial food benefit, initializes the first round order with the players that are connected at setup time, and moves the game from GameStatus.SETUP to GameStatus.IN_PROGRESS.

    • closeGame

      public void closeGame()
      Closes the match from a server-side lifecycle decision.
